newsitem.title: USA: Wyle ends associations with two firms.
newsitem.headline: Wyle ends associations with two firms.

text.p: Wyle Electronics chief executive Ralph Ozorkiewicz said he learned earlier this month that Advanced Micro Devices and Philips Semiconductors opted to end their long association with Wyle.
Shipments of AMD product represented about five percent of total sales, while Philips about two percent of Wyle's sales.

It said it has the opportunity to recover a significant portion of these sales from comparable products offered by its other suppliers, along with the ramping up of its new National Semiconductor Corp and Fairchild Semiconductor franchises, announced early in the third quarter.
The company said it continues to focus intently on asset management and was successful in reducing inventory levels by $26 million during the third quarter.
This inventory reduction provided positive cash flow which contributed to the company's improved debt leverage ratios for the quarter, it said.
